[
  {
    "i": 0,
    "architecture": "tandem_2T",
    "absorber": "wide-bandgap perovskite (1.7 eV)",
    "pce_champion": {"value": 31.28, "unit": "%", "anchor": "a maximum PCE of 31.28% with excellent operational stability is obtained in PSTSCs"},
    "pce_certified": null,
    "pce_stabilised": null,
    "active_area_cm2": null,
    "stability_protocol": null,
    "t80_h": null,
    "claims": [
      {"text": "NPBA co-SAM approach on NiOx/SAM film achieves 21.46% PCE for 1.7 eV wide-bandgap perovskite solar cells.", "anchor": "the NPBA‐incorporated wide‐bandgap perovskite solar cells, featuring a bandgap of 1.7 eV, achieve a high power conversion efficiency (PCE) of 21.46%", "evidence_type": "measurement"},
      {"text": "NPBA strengthens interfacial connection and suppresses energy losses at NiOx/SAM/perovskite interfaces.", "anchor": "introducing a bifunctional interconnector, 4‐nitrophenylboronic acid (NPBA), atop the NiO x /SAM film surface to strengthen the interfacial connection between the substrate and perovskite layer, while simultaneously suppressing the energy losses at the NiO x /SAM/perovskite interfaces", "evidence_type": "measurement"},
      {"text": "PSTSCs with NPBA-incorporated WBG perovskite achieve 31.28% PCE with excellent operational stability.", "anchor": "a maximum PCE of 31.28% with excellent operational stability is obtained in PSTSCs", "evidence_type": "measurement"}
    ]
  },
  {
    "i": 1,
    "architecture": "p-i-n",
    "absorber": "FACs",
    "pce_champion": {"value": 26.76, "unit": "%", "anchor": "The champion power conversion efficiency (PCE) of p–i–n PSCs and 12 cm 2 module reach 26.76% (certified 26.12%) and 22.77%, respectively"},
    "pce_certified": {"value": 26.12, "unit": "%", "anchor": "26.76% (certified 26.12%)"},
    "pce_stabilised": null,
    "active_area_cm2": {"value": 12, "unit": "cm2", "anchor": "12 cm 2 module"},
    "stability_protocol": "ISOS-L-1I",
    "t80_h": null,
    "claims": [
      {"text": "3TFACl additive regulates crystallization process to improve stability and scalability of FACs PSCs.", "anchor": "We introduce a multifunctional additive, 3‐(Trifluoromethyl)aniline hydrochloride (3TFACl), to effectively regulate the crystallization process to improve stability and scalability of perovskite solar cells (PSCs) through multiple interactions with perovskite components", "evidence_type": "measurement"},
      {"text": "p-i-n PSCs achieve 26.76% PCE (certified 26.12%) and 12 cm2 module reaches 22.77%.", "anchor": "The champion power conversion efficiency (PCE) of p–i–n PSCs and 12 cm 2 module reach 26.76% (certified 26.12%) and 22.77%, respectively", "evidence_type": "measurement"},
      {"text": "Unencapsulated devices retain more than 94.36% initial efficiency after 1500 h MPPT under ISOS-L-1I protocol.", "anchor": "The unencapsulated devices still maintain more than 94.36% of the initial efficiency after 1500 h maximum power point tracking (MPPT) (ISOS‐L‐1I protocol)", "evidence_type": "measurement"}
    ]
  },
  {
    "i": 2,
    "architecture": "p-i-n",
    "absorber": null,
    "pce_champion": {"value": 26.54, "unit": "%", "anchor": "we achieved a PCE of 26.54% (certified as 26.24%)"},
    "pce_certified": {"value": 26.24, "unit": "%", "anchor": "certified as 26.24%"},
    "pce_stabilised": null,
    "active_area_cm2": null,
    "stability_protocol": null,
    "t80_h": null,
    "claims": [
      {"text": "Vinylphosphonic acid (VPA) enables in situ polymerization for robust surface passivation in PSCs.", "anchor": "we report a polymerizable surface passivation material, vinylphosphonic acid (VPA). The vinyl group enables in situ polymerization, while the phosphate group passivates uncoordinated metallic defects", "evidence_type": "measurement"},
      {"text": "PVPA forms a more robust and stable passivation layer than conventional organoammonium-based small molecules.", "anchor": "the polymerized-VPA (PVPA) forms a more robust and stable passivation layer than conventional organoammonium-based small molecules", "evidence_type": "measurement"},
      {"text": "Devices retain over 90% initial PCE after 1600 h at maximum power point under continuous 1-sun illumination.", "anchor": "retaining over 90% of their initial PCE after 1600 h at maximum power point operation under continuous 1-sun illumination", "evidence_type": "measurement"}
    ]
  },
  {
    "i": 3,
    "architecture": "n-i-p",
    "absorber": null,
    "pce_champion": {"value": 26.13, "unit": "%", "anchor": "the resulting champion n‐i‐p PSC achieves a remarkable power conversion efficiency of 26.13%"},
    "pce_certified": null,
    "pce_stabilised": null,
    "active_area_cm2": null,
    "stability_protocol": null,
    "t80_h": null,
    "claims": [
      {"text": "Triple-alkali interlayer (LiOH/KCl/CsI) on ETL spatially decouples crystallization regulation from compositional modulation.", "anchor": "We introduce a triple‐alkali interlayer (LiOH/KCl/CsI) deposited on the electron transport layer prior to crystallization of the perovskite film", "evidence_type": "measurement"},
      {"text": "n-i-p PSC achieves 26.13% PCE with Voc of 1.184 V and FF of 83.81%.", "anchor": "the resulting champion n‐i‐p PSC achieves a remarkable power conversion efficiency of 26.13%, with a high open‐circuit voltage of 1.184 V and a fill factor of 83.81%", "evidence_type": "measurement"},
      {"text": "Devices maintain 93.7% efficiency after 1440 h of continuous 1-sun irradiation at 65°C.", "anchor": "the devices demonstrate robust durability maintaining 93.7% after 1440 h of continuous 1‐sun irradiation at 65°C", "evidence_type": "measurement"}
    ]
  },
  {
    "i": 4,
    "architecture": "p-i-n",
    "absorber": null,
    "pce_champion": {"value": 26.14, "unit": "%", "anchor": "PSCs achieve a power conversion efficiency (PCE) of 26.14% for 0.05 cm 2 devices"},
    "pce_certified": null,
    "pce_stabilised": null,
    "active_area_cm2": {"value": 0.05, "unit": "cm2", "anchor": "26.14% for 0.05 cm 2 devices"},
    "stability_protocol": null,
    "t80_h": null,
    "claims": [
      {"text": "Transient 2D perovskite protection using volatile propylammonium chloride shields SAMs from solvent-induced degradation.", "anchor": "we report a transient two‐dimensional (2D) perovskite protection strategy using volatile propylammonium chloride, which temporarily shields SAMs from solvent‐induced degradation and subsequently decouples during thermal annealing", "evidence_type": "measurement"},
      {"text": "30×30 cm2 module with 615.7 cm2 active area achieves 22.34% PCE.", "anchor": "22.34% for a 30 × 30 cm 2 module (615.7 cm 2 active area)", "evidence_type": "measurement"},
      {"text": "Large-area module retains 90% initial efficiency after 2000 h of continuous MPP operation.", "anchor": "the large‐area module retains 90% of its initial efficiency after 2000 h of continuous maximum power point operation", "evidence_type": "measurement"}
    ]
  },
  {
    "i": 5,
    "architecture": "p-i-n",
    "absorber": "Cs0.3MA0.15FA0.55PbI2.7Br0.3",
    "pce_champion": {"value": 23.33, "unit": "%", "anchor": "the optimized devices achieve a champion efficiency of 23.33%"},
    "pce_certified": null,
    "pce_stabilised": null,
    "active_area_cm2": null,
    "stability_protocol": null,
    "t80_h": null,
    "claims": [
      {"text": "CuF2 inserted between FTO and MeO-2PACz SAM promotes uniform SAM coverage and suppresses aggregation.", "anchor": "This strategy involves inserting copper fluoride (CuF 2 ) between the FTO substrate and MeO‐2PACz SAM layer, which promotes the formation of a uniform coverage of the MeO‐2PACz layer with suppressed aggregation due to the strong interaction between CuF 2 and MeO‐2PACz", "evidence_type": "measurement"},
      {"text": "WBG PSCs achieve champion efficiency of 23.33%.", "anchor": "the optimized devices achieve a champion efficiency of 23.33%", "evidence_type": "measurement"},
      {"text": "Device retains 90% initial efficiency after 1500 h continuous MPP operation.", "anchor": "after 1500 h of continuous operation at the maximum power point (MPP), the optimized device retains 90% of its initial efficiency", "evidence_type": "measurement"}
    ]
  },
  {
    "i": 6,
    "architecture": "p-i-n",
    "absorber": null,
    "pce_champion": {"value": 26.6, "unit": "%", "anchor": "The resulting PSCs achieve a champion power conversion efficiency of 26.6% (certified at 26.2%) for a 0.0524 cm 2 device"},
    "pce_certified": {"value": 26.2, "unit": "%", "anchor": "certified at 26.2%"},
    "pce_stabilised": null,
    "active_area_cm2": {"value": 0.0524, "unit": "cm2", "anchor": "0.0524 cm 2 device"},
    "stability_protocol": null,
    "t80_h": null,
    "claims": [
      {"text": "Hydroxylated V2C-OH MXene mixed with NiOx provides abundant hydroxyl sites for SAM anchoring.", "anchor": "we report a SAM regulation strategy by mixing hydroxylated V 2 CT x MXene (V 2 C‐OH) with nickel oxide (NiO x ), which can provide abundant hydroxyl sites for SAM anchoring, thereby forming a uniform and dense SAM layer", "evidence_type": "measurement"},
      {"text": "First-principles calculations reveal stronger binding energy between SAM and hydroxyl groups on V2C-OH than on pristine NiOx.", "anchor": "First‐principles calculations further reveal that the binding energy between SAM and hydroxyl groups on V 2 C‐OH is stronger than that on pristine NiO x", "evidence_type": "simulation"},
      {"text": "PSCs achieve 26.6% PCE (certified 26.2%) for 0.0524 cm2 and 24.7% for 1 cm2 devices.", "anchor": "The resulting PSCs achieve a champion power conversion efficiency of 26.6% (certified at 26.2%) for a 0.0524 cm 2 device and 24.7% for a 1 cm 2 device", "evidence_type": "measurement"}
    ]
  },
  {
    "i": 7,
    "architecture": "unknown",
    "absorber": null,
    "pce_champion": null,
    "pce_certified": {"value": 25.56, "unit": "%", "anchor": "achieving a certified efficiency of 25.56%"},
    "pce_stabilised": null,
    "active_area_cm2": null,
    "stability_protocol": "ISOS-LC-1",
    "t80_h": {"value": 10, "unit": "years", "anchor": "extrapolated T 80 lifetime exceeding 10 years"},
    "claims": [
      {"text": "Deep-level IFA and IPb defects identified as primary cause of device degradation via capacitance-frequency spectra analysis.", "anchor": "we identify deep‐level I FA and I Pb defects as the primary cause of device degradation based on quantitative analysis of capacitance‐frequency spectra combined with detailed balance theory", "evidence_type": "measurement"},
      {"text": "Non-intercalary ligand coordination via dual-end electropositive 3TU2+ ions passivates degradation-induced deep-level defects.", "anchor": "we design a non‐intercalary ligand coordination strategy through dual‐end electropositive 3TU 2+ ions, which effectively passivated the degradation‐induced deep‐level defects", "evidence_type": "measurement"},
      {"text": "Certified efficiency of 25.56% achieved with extrapolated T80 lifetime exceeding 10 years per ISOS-LC-1 protocol.", "anchor": "In addition to achieving a certified efficiency of 25.56%, our devices demonstrate an extrapolated T 80 lifetime exceeding 10 years, as per the ISOS‐LC‐1 protocol", "evidence_type": "measurement"}
    ]
  },
  {
    "i": 8,
    "architecture": "tandem_2T",
    "absorber": "Sn-Pb hybrid perovskite / 1.77 eV WBG perovskite",
    "pce_champion": {"value": 29.44, "unit": "%", "anchor": "APTSCs with a champion PCE of 29.44%"},
    "pce_certified": null,
    "pce_stabilised": null,
    "active_area_cm2": null,
    "stability_protocol": null,
    "t80_h": {"value": 1080, "unit": "h", "anchor": "Both devices retain approximately 80% of their initial efficiency after 1080 h of continuous operation under one‐sun illumination"},
    "claims": [
      {"text": "Lewis hard-basicity amplification strategy provides additional hard-acid binding sites and promotes coordination with Sn2+.", "anchor": "This work proposes a Lewis hard‐basicity amplification strategy that provides additional potential hard‐acid binding sites and promotes coordination with Sn 2+ , thereby enabling defect passivation and regulating crystallization", "evidence_type": "measurement"},
      {"text": "Single-junction Sn-Pb PSCs achieve champion PCE of 23.71%.", "anchor": "we achieved a champion power conversion efficiency (PCE) of 23.71% for single‐junction Sn‐Pb PSCs", "evidence_type": "measurement"},
      {"text": "All-perovskite tandem solar cells with 1.77 eV WBG top and Sn-Pb bottom achieve 29.44% PCE.", "anchor": "By integrating 1.77 eV wide‐bandgap perovskites with Sn‐Pb hybrid perovskites, we further fabricated APTSCs with a champion PCE of 29.44%", "evidence_type": "measurement"}
    ]
  },
  {
    "i": 9,
    "architecture": "tandem_2T",
    "absorber": "I-Br mixed-halide WBG perovskite (1.68/1.78 eV)",
    "pce_champion": {"value": 33.59, "unit": "%", "anchor": "the device delivers an efficiency of 33.59%"},
    "pce_certified": null,
    "pce_stabilised": null,
    "active_area_cm2": null,
    "stability_protocol": null,
    "t80_h": null,
    "claims": [
      {"text": "Molecular confinement domain with paired iodide-bearing ligands and bifunctional diammonium linker suppresses halide segregation.", "anchor": "we design a molecular confinement domain in which paired iodide‐bearing organic ligands bind adjacent FA + cations and are interconnected by a bifunctional diammonium linker, effectively suppressing halide segregation by constraining the dynamic motion of orientable FA + cations", "evidence_type": "measurement"},
      {"text": "1.68 and 1.78 eV WBG perovskite single-junction cells achieve efficiencies of 24.21% and 21.20%.", "anchor": "Such concept is applicable to both 1.68 and 1.78 eV perovskite, yielding efficiencies of 24.21% and 21.20% in single‐junction cells, respectively", "evidence_type": "measurement"},
      {"text": "Silicon-based tandem cells deliver 33.59% efficiency with T96 lifetime of 1000 h under continuous operation.", "anchor": "When integrated into silicon‐based tandem cells, the device delivers an efficiency of 33.59%, alongside durable long‐term stability with a T 96 lifetime of 1000 h under continuous operation", "evidence_type": "measurement"}
    ]
  },
  {
    "i": 10,
    "architecture": "p-i-n",
    "absorber": null,
    "pce_champion": {"value": 26.83, "unit": "%", "anchor": "Devices based on this molecularly regulated interface achieve a power conversion efficiency of 26.83%"},
    "pce_certified": null,
    "pce_stabilised": null,
    "active_area_cm2": null,
    "stability_protocol": null,
    "t80_h": null,
    "claims": [
      {"text": "N-heterocycle-activated coordination strategy stabilizes SAM organization and regulates crystallization at SAM-perovskite interfaces.", "anchor": "we report an N-heterocycle-activated coordination strategy that stabilizes SAM organization while enabling precise regulation of precursor chemistry and crystallization at SAM-perovskite interfaces", "evidence_type": "measurement"},
      {"text": "Imidazolium-derived molecules in SAMs establish cooperative coordination with lead polyhalide species, promoting phase-pure alpha-perovite formation.", "anchor": "Imidazolium-derived molecules integrated into SAMs establish cooperative coordination interactions with neighbouring lead polyhalide species, thereby reshaping the local precursor environment and directing nucleation and crystal growth", "evidence_type": "measurement"},
      {"text": "Devices achieve 26.83% PCE and retain 93.8% initial efficiency after 936 h continuous MPP operation.", "anchor": "Devices based on this molecularly regulated interface achieve a power conversion efficiency of 26.83% and retain 93.8% of their initial efficiency after 936 h of continuous maximum power point operation", "evidence_type": "measurement"}
    ]
  },
  {
    "i": 11,
    "architecture": "unknown",
    "absorber": "CsPbI3-xBrx",
    "pce_champion": {"value": 22.28, "unit": "%", "anchor": "solar cells incorporating DPS achieve a champion power conversion efficiency of 22.28%"},
    "pce_certified": null,
    "pce_stabilised": null,
    "active_area_cm2": null,
    "stability_protocol": null,
    "t80_h": null,
    "claims": [
      {"text": "Sodium 2,3-dimercapto-1-propanesulfonate (DPS) acts as a multifunctional chelating clamp via bidentate thiol coordination to undercoordinated Pb2+.", "anchor": "we introduce sodium 2,3‐dimercapto‐1‐propanesulfonate (DPS), a sulfonated thiol molecule that acts as a multifunctional chelating clamp", "evidence_type": "measurement"},
      {"text": "DPS bidentate chelation forms a stable five-membered ring with undercoordinated Pb2+ sites.", "anchor": "its two thiol groups coordinatively bind to undercoordinated Pb 2+ sites, forming a stable five‐membered ring", "evidence_type": "measurement"},
      {"text": "All-inorganic CsPbI3-xBrx PSCs achieve 22.28% PCE, among the highest for all-inorganic perovskite devices.", "anchor": "solar cells incorporating DPS achieve a champion power conversion efficiency of 22.28%, among the highest for all‐inorganic perovskite devices", "evidence_type": "measurement"}
    ]
  }
]
